items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Clark Terry had a band I worked with occasionally sometimes.

ctx.x: Drew Brown, yeah. And he was the youngest guy into the bebop thing. Everywhere we played, I used to follow him around – with him. We got to be really friendly. Mack Simpkins. He was a bad guy.
What about Clark? You just mentioned Fats.

Yeah, me and Fats was tight. We used to hang out a lot together. In fact he even lived – when I moved to – I moved to Stanton Terrace with my mother when we got out of Corcoran Street. We moved to 1892 Stanton Terrace, which is out by Alabama Road.
